scored.title: [Bug] Path traversal & symlink escape in unstream_dir() — CWE-22 / CWE-59 (ansible-runner)
scored.body_excerpt: ### Ansible Runner version devel (commit 8dcdadbd8e4a7591565bdf93c7372c157f0f08ce); also affected: 2.4.3 ### Python version Python 3.13 ### Operating System and Environment ```console Ubuntu 22.04, local clone / venv (pip install -e). Pure-stdlib reproduction; no container runtime involved. ``` ### Container Runtime N/A — bug is in unstream_dir() (zip extraction), not container-related ### Summary unstream_dir() in src/ansible_runner/utils/streaming.py extracts zip members without validating member paths or symlink targets. A crafted zip can therefore write files and create symlinks OUTSIDE its target directory (private_data_dir / artifact_dir), and can chmod/utime existing files outside the target directory. This is a path traversal (CWE-22) + link-following (CWE-59) flaw in the transmit -> worker streaming protocol's receiver. Root cause (streaming.py, unstream_dir): - out_path = os.path.join(target_directory, info.filename) # line 83, unsanitized - archive.extract(info.filename, pat
scored.rationale: Verified CWE-22/59 in unstream_dir() with root cause lines, repro steps and code snippet; small python repo with tests/CI makes fix (sanitize join + symlink check) straightforward.

scored.title: keynote-parser: arbitrary file write (zip-slip) via unsanitised ZIP member names in .key files
scored.body_excerpt: ## Summary `keynote-parser` writes ZIP member names verbatim to disk when unpacking a `.key` file, with no `basename()` stripping, no `realpath()` confinement check, and no rejection of absolute paths. An attacker-supplied `.key` archive can write arbitrary files anywhere the process has write access — well outside the designated output directory — on both Windows and POSIX systems. Tested version: **1.14.5.0** --- ## Vulnerable code **`keynote_parser/file_utils.py` — `dir_file_sink.accept()`:** ```python ensure_directory_exists(target_dir, filename) # makedirs on traversed path — outside target target_path = os.path.join(target_dir, filename) # '..' hops / absolute path drops the base open(target_path, "wb").write(data) # arbitrary write at attacker-controlled path ``` `zip_file_reader()` (lines 92–105) re-decodes member names cp437→UTF-8 (a no-op for ASCII) and skips only names ending in `/`. Every other name — including `../../../etc/cron.d/pwn`, absolute Windows paths, or UNC paths
scored.rationale: Classic Zip-Slip with vulnerable code excerpt (os.path.join without sanitization) and version; small repo with tests allows low-difficulty confinement fix.

scored.title: [Bug]: --stream 收尾对 verified_claims 做切片崩溃：get_summary() 返回计数（int），任务成功即异常退出
scored.body_excerpt: ### 结论 `vulnclaw solve --stream` / `vulnclaw run --stream` 在任务**已经成功**（flag 已取证、evidence 已落盘）之后抛 `TypeError` 退出，收尾的 `emit_complete_event()` 从未执行，进程退出码 1。 **严重性：低。** 不影响取证、报告生成与数据落盘——崩溃发生在这些动作之后； 仅影响 CLI `--stream` 模式的消费方（退出码 1、收不到 `complete` 事件）。 普通用户通过 REPL / TUI 使用时不经过该代码路径。修复成本约 2 行。 ### 环境 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | OS | Windows 11 (10.0.26200) | | Python | 3.14.5 | | VulnClaw | 0.4.1（`pip install vulnclaw`，PyPI wheel，源码零改动） | | LLM | deepseek-v4-pro（OpenAI 兼容接口） | | 相关分支 | `main`（3811 行）与 `dev`（3813 行），2026-10-26 均未修复 | ### 触发条件 只在 `verified_claims` 计数 > 0 时触发，即"真的验证成功过至少一条结论"才崩；计数为 0 时 `(0 or [])` 会退化成空列表，一切正常。所以它在失败运行里隐形、**在成功运行上必现**，CI 也容易漏掉。 ### 与模型供应商无关 - `solve`（非 `--stream`）的 `on_event` 崩溃发生在任何模型调用之前：把供应商换成不可达地址 + 假 key，**1.2 秒内**仍然复现同一个 `UnboundLocalError`，说明它根本不依赖模型。 - `--stream` 的 `TypeError` 只取决于"本次运行是否产出 ≥1 条 verified claim"：用同一个假供应商（0 条 claim）跑同一目标，**不抛** TypeError，正常输出 `{"type":"complete","summary":"⊘ not reached — steps=0 evidence=0","result":{"findings":[]}}`，退出码 0；换回可用
scored.rationale: Non-security crash bug: get_summary() returns int sliced in --stream path; has stack trace and 2-line fix description, present in repo.

scored.title: TaintAnalyzer misses taint inside expressions and treats html.escape as a shell sanitiser
scored.body_excerpt:
## Problem `TaintAnalyzer.analyze` reports `SAFE` for code where user input reaches a shell sink, as long as the input is wrapped in an expression instead of being passed as a bare name. It also counts `html.escape` as a sanitiser for shell sinks. Found in an October 2026 correctness audit. Reproduced on `main` at `10f5627` (the code is unchanged since v8.0.0). ## Reproduction ```python from qwed_new.core.taint_analyzer import TaintAnalyzer t = TaintAnalyzer() cases = { "concat": 'import os
x = input()
os.system("ls " + x)', "f-string": 'import os
x = input()
os.system(f"ls {x}")', "html.escape": 'import os, html
x = input()
y = html.escape(x)
os.system(y)', "helper": 'import os
x = input()
y = print_and_return(x)
os.system(y)', "bare name": 'import os
x = input()
os.system(x)', # control "direct": 'import os
os.system(input())', # control } for name, code in cases.items(): r = t.analyze(code) print(name, r["status"], len(r["vulnerabilities"])) ``` | Case | Observed | Expe
scored.rationale: Logic bug in TaintAnalyzer false-negatives (expressions + html.escape as sanitizer) with repro; verification-tool issue, not directly exploitable RCE.

scored.title: Unauthenticated OS Command Injection (RCE) via UVR5 "format" parameter (CVE-2025-71429 variant, unpatched)
scored.body_excerpt: ### Description Unauthenticated **OS command injection (RCE)** in the UVR5 WebUI via the **`format` (export format) parameter** - a vector not closed by CVE-2025-71429 (which concerned the output folder paths). The `format` value is never sanitized (`clean_path()` is applied only to the folder arguments) and flows straight into `os.system()`: - https://github.com/RVC-Boss/GPT-SoVITS/blob/main/tools/uvr5/vr.py#L142-L145 ```python opt_format_path = path[:-4] + ".%s" % format # attacker-controlled `format` cmd = 'ffmpeg -i "%s" -vn "%s" -q:a 2 -y' % (path, opt_format_path) os.system(cmd) # format breaks out of the "%s" quotes ``` The `if format in ["wav","flac"]` check above this block is only a format switch, not a security guard - any other value falls into this `else` branch and reaches `os.system()`. The WebUI is also exposed with no authentication, and the `gr.Radio` fixed choices (`["wav","flac","mp3","m4a"]`) are **not enforced server-side**, so the Gradio API accepts an arbitrary
scored.rationale: Real unauthenticated RCE via unsanitized format param into os.system(); code location and exploit vector detailed despite large repo.

scored.title: Nettacker module for CVE-2025-34028 (Unauthenticated Path Traversal)
scored.body_excerpt: ## Proposal I would like to propose adding a vulnerability detection module for **CVE-2025-34028**. ## Vulnerability Summary CVE-2025-34028 is an **unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability** that allows attackers to retrieve sensitive files from the server. Because the vulnerability can be triggered through crafted HTTP requests, it appears suitable for a **safe detection module** in Nettacker. ## Why This Module Is Useful - Recent vulnerability (2025) - Remotely exploitable without authentication - Detectable through non-destructive HTTP requests - Useful during reconnaissance and vulnerability scanning ## Proposed Detection Logic The module would send a crafted HTTP request attempting to access a known sensitive file path. scored.rationale: Feature request to add detection module for CVE-2025-34028, not a bug in Nettacker itself; no code to fix.
